query_text: Where can I download the latest version of Python?

request_params.system_prompt: You have a web search tool. message.content:
You can download the latest version of Python from the **official Python website**:

**https://www.python.org/downloads/**

This is the primary and most reliable source for Python downloads. The official site provides:

- Installers for **Windows**, **macOS**, and **Linux**
- Both **32-bit** and **64-bit** versions
- Various installer formats (executable installers, embeddable zip files, web-based installers)
- The **latest stable release** as well as **pre-release** versions for testing

To download:
1. Visit https://www.python.org/downloads/
2. Click on the latest Python version number displayed prominently on the page
3. Select the appropriate installer for your operating system and architecture

For Windows users specifically, you can also go directly to:
**https://www.python.org/getit/windows/**

When installing on Windows, make sure to check the box **"Add Python to PATH"** during installation so you can use Python from the command line.

---

Sources:
1. https://www.python.org/
2. https://www.python.org/downloads/
3. https://www.python.org/getit/windows/
4. https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/python/download-and-install-python-3-latest-version/
